risk: Scope explosion — the full 8-12h ten-chapter game is attempted as the first milestone
mitigation: Lock first milestone to the SEQ-04 vertical slice only (07); gate G7 before any full-game commit (15); uneven chapter scoping (06)
trigger: Any task touching a non-SEQ-04 sequence before G6 passes

risk: Screenplay-with-buttons — scenes become cutscenes with dialogue choices; no real gameplay
mitigation: Pillar 1 acceptance test (>=60% world-action inputs); 09 forces per-unit interactivity classification; core segments must justify why they need play (07)
trigger: Playtest where players describe it as 'a story I clicked through'

risk: Excessive cut-scenes crowd out interactivity
mitigation: 09 caps cinematic units; ENTRY/DECISION/CONSEQUENCE used as scene staging not cutscene (11); timing budget in 07
trigger: Cinematic minutes exceed ~25% of a chapter

risk: Weak gameplay — mechanics are shallow or unsatisfying beneath the themes
mitigation: Prototype mechanics before art (15 G2/G3); playtest fun explicitly (G6); low-cardinality high-meaning design (04)
trigger: G6 testers rate systems as tedious/pointless

risk: Repetitive feeding missions / spreadsheet management
mitigation: Diegetic spatial arrange verb not menus (04); constraints change per place; one-shot state changes no upkeep; difficulty slider (12)
trigger: Feeding scenes feel same/grindy in playtest

risk: Trivialising hunger — bowl solves hunger; poverty becomes cosmetic
mitigation: AD-0139; serve-only always fails (Pillar 3 test); anti-trivialisation checklist (04); aftermath shows unmet need
trigger: Any build where 'Distribute food' clears a scene

risk: Gamifying trauma — coercion/starvation/death staged as mechanics or spectacle
mitigation: Sensitive units kept partially-playable/cinematic (09); no violence verb (Pillar 5); trauma safeguards; specialist review before building Seq 05/06
trigger: Storyboarding SEQ-05/06 beats as playable set-pieces

risk: Romanticising coercion — Udayakumaran/Kanchanan/queen framed sympathetically enough to excuse harm
mitigation: 05 prohibited branches (no romance; no erasing consequences); RISK-007/008 controls preserved; memory is not permission modelled in GM-04
trigger: Any dialogue/choice that rewards excusing coercion

risk: False historical certainty in art/geography/costume/maritime
mitigation: Evidence labels on every asset (11/13); no fantasy stone megacity or fixed harbour (AD-0003/0005); [INTERPRETATION] never shown as [HISTORY]
trigger: An environment brief asserts a form the archive marks uncertain

risk: Flattening philosophical positions into a winning-religion quiz
mitigation: Pillar 6 acceptance test (no scored correct doctrine); steelman reconstruction (FU-054); no win-VFX (11)
trigger: Any encounter with a scored 'correct' school

risk: Inaccurate or invented Tamil; wrong terminology/orthography
mitigation: Follow 10G terminology + cue policy; validator-enforced forms; named Tamil review before any lock; DOM Tamil rendering tested (10/12)
trigger: Any new term not in the repo register; glyph rendering defects

risk: Inaccessible UI — Tamil unreadable, no scaling, colour-only info, no screen-reader path
mitigation: Tamil-first typography (11); 12 acceptance checks; DOM/HTML stack for a11y; colour-independent cues
trigger: Failing any 12 acceptance check in a build

risk: Third-party rights — translation/Venpa/font/music/photo used without clearance
mitigation: 13 rights map; status_unknown never ships; SR-013 review before public release; prefer original adaptation dialogue
trigger: Preparing any public/commercial build

risk: AI-asset provenance unclear; training-data/ownership uncertainty
mitigation: AI assets prototype-only under Option B; provenance notes required; clearance before release (13)
trigger: Shipping any AI-generated art/audio

risk: Insufficient playtesting — design assumptions never validated with real players
mitigation: Dedicated G6 player-testing gate (15); iterate G1-G4 with paper/greybox tests; bilingual testers incl. Tamil-first
trigger: Reaching art-production before a G6 pass

risk: Unsustainable full voice acting locks cost and pre-empts open dialogue lock
mitigation: Slice is text-only (11); only partial/keystone VO later after Tamil review + table-reads; full VO not planned
trigger: Commissioning full VO before dialogue lock

risk: Game work silently alters or contradicts approved screenplay/adaptation decisions
mitigation: README guardrails (no edits to docs 01-11); GD-* may not contradict 10A non-negotiables; proposed(not approved) Venpa uses treated as unavailable
trigger: Any diff to screenplay/TRACE/AD from game work

risk: Bounded agency feels fake — players resent fixed tragedies as unfair failures
mitigation: 05 fixed/variable communicated diegetically; fail-forward not game-over (03); tragedies marked as authored not skill-failure
trigger: Playtesters report 'I was punished for something I could not change'

risk: Marketing/framing drifts toward mythological power fantasy or religious propaganda
mitigation: 01 non-goals binding on marketing; no faith wins (Pillar 6); cultural review of public copy
trigger: Any promo implying combat/power/one-true-faith

risk: Solo/small-team burnout given the review-gated, multi-discipline scope
mitigation: Slice-first; text-only VO; stylised low animation scope (11); reuse screenplay/storyboard assets; phased roadmap with stop/go
trigger: Slipping G-gates repeatedly; scope creep signals
